what: From 01227: two hir-ty-ub tests/ub failures are the test programs, not the evaluator; rustc+Miri would reject or report them too. (1) simd! (3 simd tests, UnresolvedMethod([overloaded index])): `p.0[0]` needs an Index impl; rustc typeck resolves even array indexing through the Index lang item (try_index_step, then writeback strips it), so with `//- minicore: sized, copy` rustc gives E0608. Fix: `//- minicore: sized, copy, index` in the simd! macro. (2) pass_box leaks: the prelude`s `#[lang = "owned_box"] struct Box` has no Drop impl, and Box drop glue (as rustc`s elaboration) drops the contents then runs Box`s Drop impl, which is what frees; Miri would report the same leak. Fix: give the prelude Box `impl<T: ?Sized> Drop for Box<T>` calling __rust_dealloc(self.inner as *mut u8, size_of_val, align_of_val) (needs `drop` in minicore and the two intrinsics), or make pass_box free explicitly.
